## Description {#details}

<p>A parser for the __llvm_faultmaps section generated by the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/faultmaps">FaultMaps</a> class declared in <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/faultmaps-h">llvm/CodeGen/FaultMaps.h</a>.</p>


<p>This parser is version locked with with the __llvm_faultmaps section generated by the version of LLVM that includes it. No guarantees are made with respect to forward or backward compatibility.</p>
